dialect.detail: GnuCOBOL (OpenCOBOL) with Micro Focus compatibility extensions; uses $SET LINKCOUNT directive, COMP-5, CRT STATUS, CURSOR IS, CONSOLE IS CRT — typical of GnuCOBOL/Micro Focus style. Author J.W. Lemmon (APAC), GPL-licensed, version 8.15.01 August 2011.

purpose.domain_detail: Point-of-sale / job costing invoice printing system; prints invoices for jobs including job details, stock items, pricing, tax, discounts, and cash drawer control.
purpose.summary: JOBI12 is a batch invoice printing program for a job-costing/POS system. It reads job headers, job costs, debtor/customer records, stock items, and transaction data to produce formatted invoice reports. It also handles cash drawer control via a serial port and supports multiple copy types (invoice, credit note).

notable_features: LINAGE clause for page control on printer FD
CRT STATUS / CURSOR IS / CONSOLE IS CRT (screen handling)
110 COPY statements for modular file/data definitions
Cash drawer hardware control via COM1 serial port
COMP-3 packed decimal for financial calculations
REDEFINES used extensively in print record layouts
GPL license embedded in SECURITY paragraph
verdict.notes: Source truncated to first 16000 chars; full program is 3187 lines. Fixed format with occasional tab characters in comments. Decoded as latin-1. The $SET directive and COMP-5 point strongly to GnuCOBOL or Micro Focus COBOL on a PC/Unix platform. The 110 COPY statements reference an extensive library of copybooks (.SL, .FDE, .ID, .WS suffixes) typical of this author's APAC accounting suite.
